name: Torrent of Orbs
body:
School evocation [force]; Level: jester 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Prop: orb
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Targets: one, two, or three creatures, no two of which can be more than 15 ft. apart
Duration: instantaneous
Saving Throw: Reflex half; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

A series of orbs of force appear and strike the targets. Each orb deals 1d4 points of force damage. The orbs strike unerringly, even if the targets are in melee combat or have less than total cover or total concealment.
